citation: Styles, B., Stevens, E., Bradshaw, S., & Clarkson, R. (2014). Vocabulary Enrichment Intervention Programme: Evaluation report and executive summary. London: Education Endowment Foundation. (Independent evaluators: National Foundation for Educational Research, NFER.)
report_number: EEF project: Vocabulary Enrichment Intervention Programme (Vocabulary Enrichment Full Programme / Bolton EEF Literacy Transition Project), October 2014; ERIC ED581109
design: Two-arm PUPIL-randomised RCT (efficacy trial) in 12 Bolton (England) secondary schools; 649 Year 7 pupils randomised (final analysis n=282 intervention, n=288 control), stratified by timetable half within school; control = business-as-usual normal Year 7 English curriculum. Intervention = Vocabulary Enrichment Full Programme (VEIP + Sounds-Write + Literacy Plus) delivered by existing class teachers who received external training (TPD to deliver the curriculum). Subject = reading/literacy. Grade = Year 7 (low-attaining pupils, predicted KS2 Level 3-4b), i.e. transition pupils ~age 11-12 (registry grade band 3-6).
problems: Pupil-level (individual) randomisation, so this is NOT a cluster design even though pupils sit within 12 schools: the report states (p.12) 'Randomisation was carried out at the pupil level, thus cancelling out the effect of clustering... Rho can hence be regarded as zero.' School (11 dummies) was included as a fixed effect in the ANCOVA, so the impact SEs already account for school. cluster_adjusted set true; n_clusters=12 recorded for traceability; icc left null (the only ICC figure, rho=0.02 on p.11, was a conservative power-calculation assumption, NOT a reported design-effect ICC, and the actual analysis treated rho as 0 -- spec: never guess an ICC). The report's reported effect sizes (Table 10, p.18) are explicitly labelled 'Hedges' g' and were computed by EEF as (model intervention coefficient)/(pooled post-test raw SD) with small-sample correction; I reproduced them exactly (primary g=0.057 vs reported 0.06; FSM g=0.008 vs reported 0.01) using the Appendix I model coefficients (B, SE) and the Table 11 post-test SDs (pooled SD=7.057). impact_estimate/impact_se are the raw-scale ANCOVA intervention coefficient B and its SE from Appendix I (p.31-32); for the two NGRT subscales no coefficient table is given so impact_estimate/se are null and g_se was derived from the reported 95% CI. FSM model had no separate FSM post-test SD reported, so the FSM g was standardised by the overall pooled post-test SD (consistent with the report's reproduced g=0.01). Headline result: no evidence of impact (all effects non-significant).

effect_sizes.arm_label: Vocabulary Enrichment Full Programme (VEIP + Sounds-Write + Literacy Plus) vs business-as-usual
effect_sizes.test_name: GL Assessment New Group Reading Test (NGRT), composite reading score (post-test raw score, ANCOVA-adjusted for pre-test, school, sex, FSM, age)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's reported effect size = Hedges' g (Table 10, p.18). g = J * (intervention coefficient B / pooled post-test raw SD). B=0.405 (Appendix I, p.31), pooled post-test SD = sqrt(((281*6.8^2)+(287*7.3^2))/568) = 7.057 (from Table 11, p.18). d = 0.405/7.057 = 0.0574; J(df=568)=0.99868; g=0.0573 (report rounds to 0.06). g_se = J*SE_B/SD = 0.99868*0.429/7.057 = 0.0607; reproduced CI (-0.062,0.176) matches reported (-0.06,0.18). Standardised by pooled raw post-test SD.
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.18 Table 10 (primary); p.18 Table 11 (post-test SDs); p.31 Appendix I (model coefficient B, SE)
effect_sizes.notes: Primary/headline confirmatory outcome. NGRT composite = sum/aggregate of the two subscales (sentence completion + passage comprehension), both also extracted below as subscales. Non-significant (p=0.346). Pupil-level randomisation; no clustering to correct.

effect_sizes.arm_label: Vocabulary Enrichment Full Programme vs business-as-usual
effect_sizes.test_name: NGRT sentence completion subscale (post-test raw, ANCOVA-adjusted)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's reported Hedges' g (Table 10, p.18) = 0.02, 95% CI (-0.12, 0.16). g_se derived from CI: (0.16-(-0.12))/(2*1.96) = 0.0714; g_var = 0.005102. No coefficient table reported for subscales, so impact_estimate/SE and means/SDs left null.
effect_sizes.notes: Secondary outcome; one of two NGRT subscales that compose the primary composite reading score. Non-significant (p=0.804).

effect_sizes.arm_label: Vocabulary Enrichment Full Programme vs business-as-usual
effect_sizes.test_name: NGRT passage comprehension subscale (post-test raw, ANCOVA-adjusted)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's reported Hedges' g (Table 10, p.18) = 0.07, 95% CI (-0.05, 0.19). g_se derived from CI: (0.19-(-0.05))/(2*1.96) = 0.0612; g_var = 0.003748. No coefficient table reported for subscales, so impact_estimate/SE and means/SDs left null.
effect_sizes.notes: Secondary outcome; one of two NGRT subscales that compose the primary composite reading score. Non-significant (p=0.281).

effect_sizes.arm_label: Vocabulary Enrichment Full Programme vs business-as-usual - FSM-eligible subgroup (pre-specified)
effect_sizes.test_name: GL Assessment NGRT composite reading score, FSM-eligible pupils (post-test raw, ANCOVA-adjusted)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's reported Hedges' g (Table 10, p.18) = 0.01, 95% CI (-0.23, 0.25). Reproduced: B=0.056 (Appendix I FSM model, p.32), standardised by overall pooled post-test SD 7.057 -> d=0.0079; J(df=156)=0.99518; g=0.0079 (~0.01). g_se = J*SE_B/SD = 0.99518*0.866/7.057 = 0.1221; reproduced CI (-0.231,0.247) matches reported (-0.23,0.25). g_var=0.014914.
effect_sizes.page_ref: p.18 Table 10 (primary FSM); p.32 Appendix I (FSM model coefficient B, SE)
effect_sizes.notes: Pre-specified FSM-eligible subgroup (non-randomised subset). Non-significant (p=0.948). is_full_sample=false.
